name: Hive'Regal
summary: In southern Silithus, Hive'Regal's broods threaten the desert around one of its three great silithid colonies.

sections.title: The Southern Hive
sections.body: Hive'Regal spreads across southern Silithus, where silithid gather in great numbers. Resin spires rise above deep tunnels. Within them, dangerous broods range from venomous spitfires and burrowers to predatory slavemakers. The hive guards its borders and harvests organic material from travelers who stray too close.

sections.title: Subterranean Network
sections.body: Beneath Silithus's red sands, Hive'Regal's passages reach deep into the earth. Strange glyphs mark the entrance and far places within the tunnels. They suggest an organized intelligence directs the swarm, beyond mere feral instinct. Scholars and scouts study Hive'Regal and its sister hives for signs of a greater power stirring beneath the wastes.

faq.answer: Hive'Regal lies in southern Silithus, amid red sands and towering insectoid mounds.

faq.q: What kinds of creatures live in Hive'Regal?
faq.answer: Hostile silithid breeds live in Hive'Regal, including burrowers, ambushers, spitfires, and slavemakers that defend the hive.

faq.q: Why are researchers interested in Hive'Regal?
faq.answer: Scouts and scholars study Hive'Regal's strange wall glyphs to decipher them and monitor the silithid threat across southern Kalimdor.

faq.q: How does Hive'Regal differ from the other hives in Silithus?
faq.answer: Hive'Regal is the southernmost of Silithus's three major colonies, alongside Hive'Ashi and Hive'Zora. Each houses specialized silithid castes, and all appear to share a unified purpose.

angles.text: As a druid, you know the Cenarion Circle watches Hive'Regal's spread closely. The Circle sees the invasive silithid corruption as an existential blight upon the desert ecosystem.
